page.overview:
Who is The President?

The President of Ascension Arcadia Championship is a non-playable character in Final Fantasy XIV: Dawntrail. He serves as the main antagonist of the Arcadion raid series storyline.

The President of Ascension Arcadia Championship was a native of Lindblum, Alexandria's neighbor and enemy during the Storm Surge. His ancestry included a noble patron of the theatrical arts, and originally intended to pursue stage acting but instead inherited the Arcadion from his predecessor. He intended to deliver truly spectacular fights to the arena, and for this he introduced the use of feral souls to the fighters. The Arcadion's popularity soared with this new method of fighting.

The President personally introduced Retsarra, Hector and Eheeya to the Arcadion.

But when the first ever fighter developed psychonekrosis through the usage of feral souls, the President immediately regretted ever introducing them. He began to search for a cure by recruiting a scientist at Origenics, who unearthed Lindblum's abandoned research into the Lindwurm, a serpentine beast native to the nation with an advanced regenerative factor. This factor was named "Drop of Life", and it was capable of curing psychonekrosis. However, the Lindwurm needed to reach maturity first, and in order to control it, the President used feral soul infusion to absorb it into himself. He couldn't let this knowledge become public until the right time, so he confined himself to his chamber resembling a Lindblum theater in the upper levels of the Arcadion. Even though he permanently remained in the form of a Lindwurm, he was still able to maintain his sense of self, and through his regulator he was able to control machinery and address the public when needed.
